fields.title: Article / video / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). All page templates (plain article, video, programme/show) carry a NewsArticle JSON-LD block, spread near-verbatim as S1-jsonld -- on video/programme pages that node has no articleBody, only a short description. S1b-jsonld-video (a VideoObject spread) is a defensive fallback only, not observed to trigger on any sampled page. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed. Extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld, S1b-jsonld-video, or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

name.title: Name
name.description: Video title (video-mode, from VideoObject JSON-LD -- duplicates headline).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary (article-mode from NewsArticle) or the full prose recap used in place of articleBody (video-mode from VideoObject), or the raw HTML-wrapped RSS item description (latest-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, when present (article-mode only; video-mode records have no articleBody, see description instead). Contains an appended '- Ends / Published By: ... / Published On: ...' CMS boilerplate tail.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date with +05:30 IST offset.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date with +05:30 IST offset.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline as a single Person object (raw passthrough) -- usually a desk credit like 'India Today Business Desk' rather than an individual reporter.

contentUrl.title: Content URL
contentUrl.description: Direct video file/stream URL (video-mode, from VideoObject).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated topic tags, as emitted upstream (article-mode). Sometimes joined with ' ' instead of a comma -- an upstream CMS quirk, passed through as-is.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL with a trailing '?utm_source=rss' query param (latest-mode). The query param is inert -- the underlying article page loads the same with or without it.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RSS pubDate string with +05:30 IST offset (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across article, video, and latest-headline records.
